title: Sell Mineral Rights in Oval, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Oval, PA
metaDescription: Oval, Lycoming County mineral rights owner? We buy oil and gas interests in this Marcellus NE transition zone, straightforward offers, no obligation.
heroLead: Oval is a small community in Lycoming County, sitting in a transitional stretch of the Marcellus play where the dry gas of the northeast starts to shift character heading toward the more mixed geology further south, and mineral tracts here can vary a lot in value depending on exactly where the line falls.
intro: Lycoming County is Williamsport's home county, big timber and farm country before it was gas country, and a lot of the mineral interests around Oval trace back to family farms that leased acreage during the boom years without much sense of what a fair royalty rate should have looked like at the time. If that's your family's history, we can help you understand where things actually stand today.

sections.heading: Why Location Within the County Matters So Much
paragraphs: Not every acre of Lycoming County has seen the same level of drilling activity, and a tract near Oval can be worth meaningfully more or less than one on the other side of the county depending on whether it sits inside an active spacing unit. We check the recorded unit boundaries against your specific parcel before quoting anything, rather than pricing off a countywide average that doesn't reflect your ground.
If your interest has produced steadily for a number of years, we look at that royalty history closely, since it tells us more about real value than the original lease terms from a decade or more ago.

sections.heading: Handling an Interest With Multiple Heirs
paragraphs: It's common for an Oval-area tract to have passed to several siblings or cousins after a farm was sold off but the minerals retained, and getting everyone aligned on a sale can be its own project. We're happy to work with multiple heirs directly, explain the offer to each of you, and structure the paperwork so everyone's share is handled cleanly through the Lycoming County recorder of deeds in Williamsport.

faqs.question: How do I know if my Oval tract sits in a producing unit?
faqs.answer: We check recorded unit and lease records against your parcel description as part of our free review and tell you exactly where things stand.

faqs.question: My siblings and I inherited the interest together. Can you buy from all of us at once?
faqs.answer: Yes, we regularly handle sales involving multiple heirs and coordinate the paperwork so each person's share is documented properly.

faqs.question: What if the interest has never produced any royalty?
faqs.answer: We can still make an offer on unleased or non-producing interests, priced against nearby activity rather than an existing royalty history.
